label: voxel-session_d
args:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y openssh-server python3
mkdir -p /run/sshd
ssh-keygen -A
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIHENcJN/BcnV9w1ww6bQ/EjX1n907eHUqcOZA+bNegwk opencl mac13' > /etc/jpdc_authorized_keys
chown root:root /etc/jpdc_authorized_keys
chmod 600 /etc/jpdc_authorized_keys
exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -p 2200 -oAuthorizedKeysFile=/etc/jpdc_authorized_keys -oPermitRootLogin=prohibit-password -oPasswordAuthentication=no -oKbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -oUsePAM=yes
